name: Brunei
officialName: Nation of Brunei, Abode of Peace

flag.description: A yellow field crossed by two parallel diagonal bands, white above black, running from the upper hoist to the lower fly, with the red national emblem in the centre.
flag.symbolism: Yellow is the colour of the Sultan, while the white and black bands represent his chief ministers; the emblem's crescent stands for Islam, the parasol for the monarchy and the upraised hands for the government's benevolence.

hook: Brunei is the yellow flag slashed by a white-and-black diagonal, with a red crest of a crescent, parasol and two raised hands in the middle.
trivia: The Arabic motto on the crescent means "Always in service with God's guidance".
Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah has reigned since 1967, making him one of the longest-reigning monarchs in the world.
